## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Khaggavisāṇasuttaniddesa* (Cnd 23) is an early exegetical work forming part of the *Cūḷaniddesa* in the Khuddaka Nikāya. Translated as the "Exposition of the Rhinoceros Horn Discourse," the work provides a detailed word-by-word commentary and doctrinal exposition on the *Khaggavisāṇa Sutta* (Snp 1.3). The commentary on this text, the *Khaggavisāṇasuttaniddesavaṇṇanā*, is preserved as part of the Khuddaka Nikāya commentary (*KN-aṭṭhakathā* / *Saddhammapajjotikā*) [Schlosser 2016].

 Cross-canonically, the underlying verses are cited or paralleled across numerous traditions, including the Gāndhārī *Rhinoceros Sūtra* (GF 5B), Chinese Āgama and Dharmapada parallels (e.g., SA 1176, MA 72, T 210.31), Sanskrit Udānavarga recensions (UV 14), and Mūlasarvāstivāda Vinaya literature.
